title: Hold a commercial radio broadcasting licence
what: Providing a commercial radio broadcasting service needs a licence from the ACMA.

sources.title: Broadcasting Services Act 1992
sources.quote: A person must not provide a commercial radio broadcasting service unless the person has a licence to provide that service.

sources.title: Broadcasting Services Act 1992
sources.quote: 40 Allocation of other licences (1) The ACMA may allocate to a person, on application in writing by the person, a commercial television broadcasting licence or a commercial radio broadcasting licence that is not a licence referred to in subsection 36(1).
